# Full dep list for aspect-seeing. Installed in one pip call so that torch
# cannot be clobbered by transitive deps of sae-lens / transformer-lens.
# scripts/bootstrap.sh adds --extra-index-url for PyTorch cu124 wheels.
#
# torch 2.7.1 / cu124 pairs with CUDA 12.4 and is the floor that keeps
# sae-lens 6.x and nnsight 0.6.x resolvable. The design doc still mentions
# torch==2.3.1; that entry is out of date.

# Torch stack — exact pin to prevent any transitive dep from clobbering it.
torch==2.7.1
torchvision==0.22.1
torchaudio==2.7.1

# HF stack — 4.56.x is the current 4.x line; stay off transformers 5.x for now.
transformers>=4.56,<4.60
accelerate>=0.30
huggingface_hub>=0.24
safetensors>=0.4

# SAE + interpretability
sae-lens>=6.0
nnsight>=0.3
einops>=0.8

# Vision / image gen
open-clip-torch>=2.24
diffusers>=0.30
pillow>=10.2

# Experiment infra
wandb>=0.17
hydra-core>=1.3
pyyaml>=6.0
tqdm>=4.66
gdown>=5.0          # Panagopoulou dataset images live on Google Drive

# Analysis
pandas>=2.2
scikit-learn>=1.4
matplotlib>=3.8
